## deploy_packages

Deploy a list of Zarf packages to a cluster with component-level drift detection.

Include it as `colonel_byte.zarf.deploy_packages`.

Added in `colonel_byte.zarf` 0.31.0.

Iterates over a list of Zarf packages to deploy, inspecting each package definition and checking installed cluster components before deploying.

An item that names components is skipped when every one of them is already deployed on the cluster at the same package version, and no excluded component is. An item that names none is always deployed: the role compares component names, and with none to compare it has nothing to go on.

Skipping settles for a package that one item deploys. It does not settle for a package that several items deploy in phases, because `zarf package list` reports only the most recent deploy's components -- so each phase sees the other's and both re-deploy every run. That reconciles rather than fails; see the `choice-deploy-packages-drift-scope` page in the book.

When deployment is executed, invokes `zarf_init` for packages of type `init`, or `zarf_package_deploy` for standard packages. Both verify the package against `zarf_public_key` when one is named.

Optionally writes deployment results as JSON files to `zarf_result_dir`, refreshes the `zarf_packages` fact once the stack is deployed, and sets `zarf_deploy_packages_changed` to whether any item reached zarf.

Every task carries `run_once: true` and delegates to `zarf_delegate_to`.
